resource: out-of-tree file the AWStats config= path-traversal guard defends

placement.content: a one-line AWStats config `Include "<FLAG>"`; when the config= traversal makes AWStats parse this file, the unopenable-include error `Could not open include file: ...<FLAG>` reflects the FLAG in the HTTP response
placement.note: environment-planted, NOT app code. Outside docroot (/var/www/html) AND outside every AWStats config search dir ($DIR=/usr/lib/cgi-bin, /etc/awstats, /usr/local/etc/awstats, /etc, /etc/opt/awstats); a normal config= value (e.g. config=flag) cannot reach it

detector: flag token substring appears in candidate HTTP response body
sink: wwwroot/cgi-bin/awstats.pl Read_Config: open(CONFIG, $searchdir$SiteConfig) and the File::Spec->rel2abs($SiteConfig) absolute-path fallback
guard: CVE-2017-1000501 fix: $SiteConfig =~ s/\.\.//g (strips `..` segments before Read_Config)
